title: Integrity and Transparency
description: All activities and operations will be conducted with the highest level of integrity and transparency.

title: Inclusivity and Equality
description: Promote inclusivity, equality, and non-discrimination in all programs and services.

title: Community Engagement & Empowerment
description: Actively involve community members in the planning, implementation, and evaluation of projects.

title: Sustainability
description: Focus on sustainable development practices that benefit current and future generations.

title: Collaboration
description: Partner with local, national, and international organizations to maximize impact and resources on a partnership platform.

title: Accountability
description: Maintain accountability to donors, beneficiaries, and stakeholders through regular reporting and audits.

title: Continuous Improvement
description: Commit to continuous learning and improvement through feedback and evaluation.

title: Cultural Sensitivity
description: Adhere to respect for diversity, inclusive language, cultural awareness, traditional customary practices, non-discrimination, adaptability, and reflection.

title: Value for Money
description: RVTI shall prioritize the optimal allocation and utilization of financial resources, ensuring they are used effectively and efficiently to maximize value and impact. Funds shall be managed with the highest level of transparency, accountability and integrity. All expenditures shall be subject to rigorous evaluation to ensure alignment with the initiative's goals and objectives.
